map.：nu = - epsilon_lat / epsilon_ax。拉伸时轴向伸长: nu = -epsilon_lat/epsilon_ax. Under tension the axial direction lengthens and the lateral narrows, and the Poisson ratio describes this ratio. Metals are about 0.3, rubber near 0.5 and cork near 0.
map.：各向同性线弹性材料 nu 在 -1 到 0.5 之间；0.5 为不可压缩（如橡: For isotropic linear elastic materials nu ranges from -1 to 0.5; 0.5 means incompressible (such as rubber) and negative values are auxetic materials (rare).
map.普通材料不能（会违反体积正定性）；0.5 是各向同性不可压缩上限。特殊拉胀材料: Ordinary materials cannot do this (it would violate volumetric positivity); 0.5 is the upper limit of isotonic incompressibility. Special auxetic materials have nu < 0 (they widen laterally when pulled).
map.橡胶近似不可压缩，体积几乎不变，轴向拉长必靠横向收缩补偿，故 nu→0.5。: Rubber is nearly incompressible so the volume barely changes; axial stretching must be compensated by lateral contraction, which is why nu approaches 0.5.
